settings.name_in_paper: Decentralized multi-player Bernoulli bandit with sensing (observation models 1 and 2)
unmapped: M decentralized players (M <= K), no communication; collisions give zero reward (full reward occlusion)
Players know the number of players M
Sensing information Y_{A^j(t),t} observed (model 1: sensing and collision simultaneously; model 2: sensing then collision only if channel free)
Instance in P_M: strict gap mu_M^* > mu_{M+1}^* between M best and the other arms
Regret compares to oracle assigning the M players to the M best arms
settings.definition_quote: We consider a $K$-armed Bernoulli bandit model ... there are $M \in \{1,\dots,K\}$ players ... player $j$ then receives (and observes) the binary rewards $r^j(t) := Y_{A^j(t),t} \; \indic(\overline{C^j(t)})$. ... $R_T(\boldsymbol{\mu}, M, \rho) := \left(\sum_{k=1}^{M}\mu_k^*\right)T - \E_{\mu}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\sum_{j=1}^M r^j(t)\right]$.

symbols.mu_i: mean of a worst (non-M-best) arm k

conditions: for every player j and every arm k among the K-M worst arms

source.label: thm:BetterLowerBound
source.quote: Under observation models $\modelun$ and $\modeldeux$, for any strongly uniformly efficient \emph{decentralized} policy $\rho$ and $\boldsymbol{\mu}\in\cP_M$, $\forall j, \forall k \in \Mworst, \liminf_{T\to \infty} \frac{\E_{\mu}[T_k^j(T)]}{\log(T)} \geq \frac{1}{\kl(\mu_k, \mu_M^*)}$.

results.notes: Lower bound on expected number of selections of a worst arm by each player.

symbols.sum_subopt: here: sum over the K-M worst arms (Mworst)

source.label: thm:BetterLowerBound
source.quote: From Lemma~\ref{lem:1stLowerBound}, it follows that $\liminf_{T \to +\infty} \frac{R_T(\boldsymbol{\mu}, M, \rho)}{\log(T)} \geq M \times \left( \sum_{k \in \Mworst} \frac{(\mu_M^* -  \mu_k)}{\kl(\mu_k, \mu_M^*)} \right)$.

results.notes: Regret is system regret vs. the oracle assigning players to the M best arms; defined through expected rewards, i.e. pseudo-regret. Comparator mapped to best_fixed_action (best fixed allocation).

conditions: k is one of the K-M worst arms
tuning: exploration function f(t) = log(t) + 3 log log(t)

source.label: lem:SubOptimalSelections
source.quote: For any $\boldsymbol{\mu}\in\cP_M$, if player $j\in\{1,\dots,M\}$ uses the \RandTopM-, \MCTopM- or \rhoRand-\klUCB{} decentralized policy with exploration function $f(t) = \log(t) + 3 \log\log(t)$, then for any sub-optimal arm $k \in \Mworst$, there exists two problem depend constants ... $\E_{\mu}[T_k^j(T)] \leq \frac{\log(T)}{\kl(\mu_k,\mu_{M}^*)}+ C_{\boldsymbol{\mu}} \sqrt{\log(T)} + D_{\boldsymbol{\mu}}\log\log(T) + 3M + 1$.

results.notes: Bound on expected sub-optimal selections per player; same lemma covers RandTopM and rhoRand (r4, r5). Explicit constants in eq. UBprecise.

symbols.S_kl: sum over pairs (a,b) with mu_a < mu_b of 1/kl(mu_a, mu_b)

source.label: lem:collisionsMCTopM
source.quote: For any $\boldsymbol{\mu}\in\cP_M$, if all players use the \MCTopM-\klUCB{} decentralized policy, and $M \leq K$, then the total average number of collisions (on all arms) is upper-bounded by $\E_{\mu}\left[\sum_{k=1}^K \cC_k(T)\right] \leq M^2\left(2 M + 1\right) \left(\sum_{a,b=1,\dots,K,\;\mu_a < \mu_b} \frac{1}{\kl(\mu_a,\mu_b)}\right) \log(T) + \smallO{\log T}$.

results.notes: Bound on expected total number of colliding players; '+o(log T)' expressed as limsup of ratio to log T.

symbols.G_Mmu: problem-dependent constant G_{M,mu} depending on mu and M

tuning: exploration function f(t) = log(t) + 3 log log(t) (as in Lemma 8)

source.label: thm:LogarithmicRegret_MCTopMklUCB
source.quote: If all $M$ players use \MCTopM-\klUCB, and $M \leq K$, then for any problem $\boldsymbol{\mu} \in \cP_M$, there exists a problem dependent constant $G_{M,\boldsymbol{\mu}}$, such that the regret satisfies: $R_T(\boldsymbol{\mu}, M, \rho) \leq G_{M,\boldsymbol{\mu}} \log(T) + \smallO{\log T}$.

results.notes: Constant G not explicit in statement; follows from Lemmas 3, 7, 8, 10. Expressed as limsup R_T/log T <= G. Exploration function assumption inherited from Lemma 8.
